build_steps.description: Install system dependencies required for PHP extension compilation
build_steps.reason: System libraries needed for GD, ZIP, mbstring, and XML extension compilation

build_steps.description: Install PHP extensions: non-dom extensions first, then dom-dependent extensions together at the end
build_steps.run_command: docker-php-source extract && docker-php-ext-install fileinfo ctype iconv mbstring zip && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg && docker-php-ext-install gd && docker-php-ext-install dom xml xmlreader xmlwriter simplexml && docker-php-source delete
build_steps.reason: docker-php-ext-install cleans up after each extension internally. Installing dom-dependent extensions (dom, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, simplexml) together at the end ensures dom headers remain available for xmlreader compilation. Non-dom extensions (fileinfo, ctype, iconv, mbstring, zip, gd) are installed first.

build_steps.description: Verify PHP extensions are installed via php -m
Materialize repository at /workspace via git partial clone

notes: eval.sh and test assets are runtime-mounted, not baked into the image. repo_setup.sh runs before setup_runtime.sh during build. PHP extensions are installed in a single RUN command with non-dom extensions first, then dom-dependent extensions together at the end: docker-php-source extract && docker-php-ext-install fileinfo ctype iconv mbstring zip && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg && docker-php-ext-install gd && docker-php-ext-install dom xml xmlreader xmlwriter simplexml && docker-php-source delete. This approach avoids docker-php-ext-install cleaning up dom headers before xmlreader compiles.
